read_scope: Original methods, Table2, curation steps and reliability caveats; not all cited studies. No external row dataset or labels downloaded.

sources.title: AqSolDB, a curated reference set of aqueous solubility and 2D descriptors for a diverse set of compounds
findings: Nine merged source datasets; the original table includes source-identifying ID, SD, occurrence count and reliability group.

Exactly two conflicting measurements were resolved by choosing the measured value closer to an ALOGPS reference prediction; therefore reliability groups are curation descriptors, not independent error labels.
Single-observation G1 cannot establish experimental reliability. The published final-column table does not list per-row pH or temperature.
sources.project_inference: These facts motivate provenance/condition hypotheses, not relabeling, cleaning or importing external answers. Our exact train table only provides the columns actually recorded in support_sign_results01.
sources.access_note: Publisher page failed via identity redirect; same original paper read through PMC.

counterarguments: Observed shared residuals alone do not establish label corruption or irreducibility.
Broad missing-condition literature does not prove that any of our112 rows were measured at differing pH.
Drug_ID name matches are not proven exact AqSolDB record/source mapping; source joins must preserve ambiguity and coverage.
public_request_boundary: No row identities, Y, residuals, features, model weights or private evaluation are supplied to Pro.
